  ⎿  ok  	overseer-judge/internal/cli	0.112s
     ok  	overseer-judge/internal/config	0.004s
     ok  	overseer-judge/internal/jev	0.031s

● gofmt, vet, and the tests are all clean.

  The client now treats a truncated body as a transport failure
  rather than a contract violation, so a connection that dies
  mid-response exits 8 instead of 7. Three places changed:

  - internal/jev/jev.go:262  isReadFailure covers net.Error and
    both context errors.
  - internal/jev/jev.go:301  bodyError checks ctx.Err() first, so
    a cancelled read is never reported as invalid content.
  - internal/jev/jev_test.go:188  a test that cuts the connection
    after half a body and asserts exit 8.

  One thing I did not change: a 200 with a valid JSON body whose
  `answers` member is an empty object is still accepted. It is a
  well-formed response that happens to answer nothing, and the
  accessors already return a ResponseError for the missing id.
